messages.subject: Dispute with Caldervale - need to instruct you
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Things with Caldervale have gone badly wrong. They've withheld our Milestone 4 and integration payments (£1,437,500 in total) and last month they purported to terminate the contract and reject the whole system, blaming us for missing the throughput targets.

We're convinced the underperformance was down to their data and their hosting environment, not our robots. We'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter to recover what we're owed. Can we talk this week?

Marcus

messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Thank you - sorry to hear it has come to this. We can certainly act. Tom Gallagher (copied) will lead day to day with me supervising.

To get going we'll need the signed Agreement and all six schedules, your acceptance-test logs, the invoices, and the termination correspondence. Our first step will be a robust letter before action. Could you also let us have a short chronology from your side?

We'll send our engagement letter today.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
